privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be saved at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/reversal_learning.psyexp. The conditions file must be at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/spatial_positions.csv with columns 'left_color', 'right_color', and 'corr_ans'. The reversal logic must trigger after 8 consecutive correct responses. The reward probability is 80% for the target color. Required data variables to be logged are 'win_outcome', 'current_target', and 'reversed'. Feedback text must be 'WIN!' (green) or 'NOTHING' (white).
